feature.label: AfterGit Merge Resolver: Resolve with AI
feature.description: Lets AfterGit ask a language model (the Anthropic Messages API, or an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions server such as OpenAI, Ollama or LM Studio) to resolve a conflict; every answer is a proposal you review in AfterGit. Off until you allow it under Preferences > AfterGit > Resolve with AI. AfterGit works without this feature.
